narrative: Credit losses are a €3.5M net release year-to-date against a €12.3M charge in the budget and €15.8M in 2025. Most of the release comes from two resolved corporate cases and lower model-based ECL as house prices stabilised. A normal year for Aktia is 15–20 bps on a €7.9bn book — €12–16M — and that is how Q4 and 2027 should be planned.
